Standalone entries listed here that don't exist in parsed.json become fully hand-rolled units; they must specify all required fields.

adeptus_mechanicus_archaeopter_fusilave.notes: ADMECH-DIAG: BSData maps four Crusade-only Archeotech upgrade weapons (Electro-fused Vambraces, Nanoshard Projector, Digital Cannon, Neural Jammer) onto Archaeopter chassis as standard ranged profiles. BSData cache Imperium - Adeptus Mechanicus.cat.gz shows each has cost block <cost name=pts value=0/> but <cost name=Crusade Points value=1/>, and all four sit inside an Archeotech selectionEntryGroup with a max=1 constraint - these are CRUSADE narrative upgrades, not matched-play wargear. The BSData mapper has no Crusade-Points filter, so these become primary+secondary+extras and the simulator fires several of them per shooting phase. Real Fusilave datasheet (Wahapedia https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adeptus-mechanicus/#Archaeopter-Fusilave): only Cognis heavy stubber array (twin-linked, 36in 9A S4 AP0 D1 Sustained 1, Rapid Fire 9), Bombs (one-shot Drop Bomb action, not modelled), and Armoured hull (melee). Structural fix (Crusade-Points filter in code/bsdata/mapper.py) is iter 31-45 mapper phase 2.

adeptus_mechanicus_archaeopter_stratorap.notes: ADMECH-DIAG: Crusade-only Archeotech weapons mapped onto Stratoraptor secondary+extras - see adeptus_mechanicus_archaeopter_fusilave notes. Real Stratoraptor datasheet (Wahapedia https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adeptus-mechanicus/#Archaeopter-Stratoraptor): Twin cognis lascannon (already primary), Cognis heavy stubber array (36in 9A S4 AP0 D1 Sustained 1, Rapid Fire 9), Armoured hull (melee). Override moves real Cognis stubber to secondary and clears Crusade extras.

adeptus_mechanicus_archaeopter_transvect.notes: ADMECH-DIAG: Crusade-only Archeotech weapons mapped onto Transvector - see adeptus_mechanicus_archaeopter_fusilave notes. adepta_sororitas_castigator.notes: SOROR-STAT-AUDIT: Castigator's two main guns â€” Castigator battle cannon and Castigator autocannons â€” are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE wargear options per Wahapedia datasheet. The BSData 'Main gun' selectionEntryGroup wraps both as max=1 children with a defaultSelectionEntryId on the autocannons, meaning the model picks exactly one. Wahapedia (https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adepta-sororitas/#Castigator) states the wargear options as: 'A Castigator is equipped with: 3 heavy bolters; Castigator battle cannon; armoured tracks. The Castigator battle cannon can be replaced with Castigator autocannons.' One main gun, not both. The mapper packed battle cannon into the primary slot (A=D6+3 avg 6, S10 AP-1 D3, Blast/Ignores Cover) and autocannons into the secondary slot (A=4 with Rapid Fire 4 i.e. 8 in range, S9 AP-1 D3, Twin-Linked) so the simulator was firing BOTH every Shooting phase, ~24 extra wound output per round on top of the 3 heavy bolters + storm bolter + hunter-killer in extra_ranged_profiles. Cleared the secondary slot to leave only the battle cannon firing alongside the always-carried wargear in extras. Castigator is in the Sororitas archetype list so this lands directly on the Sororitas eval signal. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adepta-sororitas/#Castigator

adepta_sororitas_exorcist.notes: SOROR-MUTEX-2: Exorcist's two main guns — Exorcist missile launcher and Exorcist conflagration rockets — are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE wargear options per Wahapedia datasheet. adepta_sororitas_immolator.notes: SOROR-MUTEX-2: Immolator has THREE mutually-exclusive main guns — twin multi-melta, immolation flamers, twin heavy bolter — per Wahapedia datasheet. The BSData 'Main gun' selectionEntryGroup wraps all three as max=1 children, meaning the model picks exactly one. Wahapedia (https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adepta-sororitas/#Immolator) states: 'One Immolator is equipped with: 1 storm bolter; 1 hunter-killer missile; 1 immolation flamers OR 1 twin multi-melta OR 1 twin heavy bolter; armoured tracks.' One main gun, not all three. The mapper packed the twin multi-melta (S9 AP-4 D6, Melta 2, Twin-Linked) into the primary slot, the immolation flamers (D6 shots, S6 AP-1 D1, Torrent/Ignores Cover) into the secondary slot, AND the twin heavy bolter (3 shots, S5 AP-1 D2, Sustained Hits 2, Twin-Linked) into extra_ranged_profiles — so the simulator was firing all three every Shooting phase. Picked twin multi-melta as primary (popular anti-tank meta choice), cleared secondary, and replaced extra_ranged_profiles with only the Hunter-killer missile (the only legitimate always-carried ranged wargear from the codex equipment line that BSData also exposes; storm bolter isn't mapped into extras). The pre-existing 'Heavy Bolter' entry in BSData's extras is not in the real codex equipment line and is dropped here as well to avoid stacking another spurious gun. Same pattern as the SOROR-STAT-AUDIT Castigator cleanup. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/adepta-sororitas/#Immolator

orks_stompa.notes: Multi-weapon override (option 1 / pass 1). The Stompa carries six ranged weapons but BSData's tree exposes only the Deffkannon (primary in the simulator: A=3D6 -> 10 shots, S14, AP-3, D6 Blast) and the Supa-gatler (secondary: 20 shots, S7, AP-1, D2, Sustained Hits 1). The other three weapon profiles are absent from the cache: 3 Big Shootas + 1 Twin Big Shoota (Rapid Fire 2, 36", S5 AP0 D1), the Skorcha (D6 shots, 12" Torrent, S5 AP-1 D1, Ignores Cover), and the Supa-rokkits (D6 shots, 100", S12 AP-3 D6+2, Blast). The simulator runs Stompa with roughly 60-70%% of its real shooting output, which is the primary reason it collapses in the equation fit. As a stopgap until the mapper learns to compose multi-weapon profiles, we route the Supa-rokkits' anti-vehicle contribution into the primary slot (Deffkannon-like S14/AP-3) by bumping attacks 10 -> 14, and the Big Shootas + Twin Big Shoota + Skorcha anti-infantry contribution into the secondary slot (Supa-gatler-like S7/AP-1) by bumping attacks 20 -> 32. Keyword booleans (Blast on primary, Sustained Hits 1 on secondary) are kept as-is from BSData. The override is rough â€” different missing weapons have different S/AP profiles so any single-slot aggregation distorts target-type efficiency â€” but it lifts Stompa's expected damage from ~12 to ~17 vs a baseline Marine, which matches the Wahapedia datasheet. Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/orks/Stompa
